title: The Glorious Quran
description:
Glorious Quran is a complete Quran reading, listening, learning, and Salah companion from Minhaj-ul-Quran International.

Read the Holy Quran by Surah, Juz, or Mushaf page, listen to beautiful recitations, explore multilingual translations, save bookmarks, return with restore points, search across Quran text, and use Qibla and Salah tools in one thoughtfully designed app.

The app features Manifest Quran and Irfan-ul-Quran by Shaykh-ul-Islam Dr. Muhammad Tahir-ul-Qadri, a clear and contemporary translation known for conveying Quranic meaning with context while remaining faithful to the original Arabic.

Version 4 brings a richer, more modern experience, including IQVoice command support, selected artificial intelligence-assisted support features, Mushaf-page reading, improved audio playback, offline recitation support, Qibla and Salah tools, enhanced themes, flexible fonts, and multilingual interface support.

Where available, the app's artificial intelligence-assisted support features are designed to help with discovery, navigation, and learning support while keeping the Quran text, translations, recitations, Qibla, and Salah tools at the center of the experience.

Key features:

- Complete Quran text with smooth reading controls
- Read by Surah, Juz, or Mushaf page
- Irfan-ul-Quran translations in multiple languages
- 80+ additional translations and transliterations
- Verse-by-verse reading with flexible language display
- IQVoice commands for hands-friendly app control
- Artificial intelligence-assisted support features, where available
- Audio recitation with full player controls
- Offline playback for downloaded recitations
- Repeat options, quality settings, and full Quran playback
- Multilingual search with highlighted results
- Bookmarks and restore points
- Auto-scroll with adjustable speed
- Qibla and Salah tools
- Custom themes, fonts, text size, spacing, and visibility options
- Localized interface in many languages

Supported language examples include English, Urdu, Bengali, Hindi, Finnish, Norwegian, Sindhi, Arabic-English transliteration, Albanian, Amazigh, Azerbaijani, Bosnian, Chinese, Dutch, French, German, Indonesian, Malay, Persian, Spanish, Turkish, Uzbek, and many more.

Whether you are reciting daily, listening on the go, comparing translations, studying a topic, improving your Quran knowledge, or keeping Salah tools close at hand, Glorious Quran is designed to make regular Quran engagement easier, clearer, and more consistent.

The app has no ads, no subscriptions, and no in-app purchases.
